plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Microwave Networks Proteus AMT / MX microwave radios (MNI-PROTEUS-AMT-MIB, enterprise PEN 3323). It reports uptime, RFU temperature, transmit power and received signal level per radio, and interface traffic.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature of each radio frequency unit (RFU) of the Proteus microwave radio in degrees Celsius, from mnPrPerfBaseRFUTemp (MNI-PROTEUS-AMT-MIB, 1.3.6.1.4.1.3323.13.1.4.1.1.20, INDEX mnInterfaceIndex). Tributary rows are skipped; values outside -60 to 150 are dropped.

metrics.name: radio_tx_power_dbm
metrics.description: Actual transmit power of each radio in dBm, from mnPrPerfBaseTxPower (1.3.6.1.4.1.3323.13.1.4.1.1.2). The status codes -100 (unknown), -101 (transmitter failed) and -102 (muted) are not power readings and are dropped.

metrics.name: radio_rsl_dbm
metrics.description: Received signal level of each radio in dBm, from mnPrPerfBaseRSL (1.3.6.1.4.1.3323.13.1.4.1.1.3). -99 means no RFU is attached and is dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
